Name: Monster Allergies
Author: Pokkki
Description:
[size=5][b]What does it do?[/b][/size]
[size=3]
Adds various allergies to monster drops and monster loot to the game, which can be toggled on or off via BarleyZP's Allergies menu. So far, the allergies added are:

[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Slime[/size]
[*][size=3]Bats[/size]
[*][size=3]Magic Essences[/size]
[*][size=3]Bug Meat[/size]
[/list]
[size=3]and products and objects made from and with these items. I included a few mods and will include more in the future, you can request additions in the posts. Reactions happen from holding, and, if available, eating an item. Reactions and their severity are set globally in BarleyZP's Allergies mod menu and are out of the scope of my influence, so if you want more or different reactions, I suggest bringing those over to that mod. [/size][list]
[/list][size=3]
[/size][size=3] 
[/size][size=5][b]Compatibility [/b][/size][size=3]so far with:

[/size][list]
[*][size=3][size=3]A[/size]dventurer's Guild Expanded for 1.6[/size]
[*][size=3]Ridgeside Village[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[/size][size=5][b]To install: [/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*][size=3]Have SMAPI and Content Patcher installed.[/size]
[*][size=3]Download this mod.[/size]
[*][size=3]Unpack the zip file you downloaded.[/size]
[*][size=3]Put the folder from the unpacked zip file into your mods folder.[/size]
[*][size=3]The mod is now installed. Allergies will be found in BarleyZP's Allergies mod menu.[/size]
[/list][size=3]If you run into problems with installing this mod, best go to the [url=https://discord.com/invite/stardewvalley]Stardew Valley Discord [/url]﻿and ask for help there.[/size]
